# BeatAPI Agent Plugin

BeatAPI is the **professional capability layer for any agent**: one route to Model, Data, Tool,
and

Workspace capabilities. This plugin connects Codex, Cursor, Grok Bot, and
Grok Build to BeatAPI thro

ugh a bundled Skill, local MCP server, typed client,
and locked public contract.

The existing host installations below use local stdio MCP. The OpenAI public
release is a separate r

emote MCP + OAuth package under preparation; it does not
require users to install a CLI or provide k

eys in chat. The owner has confirmed
the hosted ChatGPT OAuth connection and tool invocation. Full r

eview cases,
the demo recording and public submission remain separate acceptance gates.
This reposit

ory does not configure or deploy the hosted service.
See public submission for the build and review

gates.
The public listing is named **BeatAPI Agent Toolkit**; its stable package ID
remains `beatapi
-agent-plugin`, and existing local host manifests are unchanged.

The remote Skill is general-purpose: social/web research, SEO keyword and competitor
analysis, text

and decision models, image/video generation and media workflows.
Research, SEO analysis and creative

production can be used independently or combined.
SEO traffic figures are estimates, and ranking po

sitions are dated snapshots, not live tracking.
Social data is read/research
only, not social postin

g. Public execution tools are generated individually from
gateway capability contracts; local `capab

ilities_*` interfaces stay compatible.
`npm run submission:catalog -- --fetch` reads the anonymous c

atalog only and writes
tool definitions, fixed-reference bindings and exclusions under `dist/submiss

ion/`.
These artifacts still need the hosted gateway's OAuth/transport activation; generating them
d

oes not deploy a remote server or prove that every listed capability succeeds.
Public packaging also

requires a pinned v2 catalog and a matching anonymous SDK
tool scan, not just OAuth metadata. Probe

reports distinguish blocked, OAuth-only
and metadata-matched states; none substitutes for real user
/workflow review tests.

## Architecture

The host-specific manifests are thin adapters. Product behavior stays local to
the shared Skill, MCP

server, typed client, and contract, so fixes do not drift
across separate repositories.
## Unified capability and Web tools (0.4.0)

The bundled local MCP now exposes `capabilities_search`, `capabilities_inspect`,
`capabilities_run`,

`web_search`, `web_read`, `web_map`, and `web_research`, matching
remote MCP at `https://beatapi.io

/mcp`. Existing `beatapi_*` tools remain available.
Search/Inspect require no key. Run and Web calls

use host-configured credentials
or the CLI credential store (requires CLI 0.4.0). Never pass a key

ed credentials
or the CLI credential store (requires CLI 0.4.0). Never pass a key in tool arguments.

Search supports compact/full views and function grouping. Run supports start,
status and result, plu

s preview, fields and max_items. A stored result is free to
read within one hour. Research may retur

n a task; poll instead of starting again.
Models and prices come from live discovery; no list of new
model IDs is embedded.
